candidates.rationale: Paul expresses confidence that God who began a good work will carry it on to completion, perfect for ongoing work with a long road ahead.
The completion of Jerusalem's wall in just 52 days despite opposition shows that even massive unfinished projects can reach their goal.
The vision awaits an appointed time and will not fail though it tarries, encouraging patience and optimism when the goal seems distant.
Paul planted, Apollos watered, but God gives growth—showing that in-progress work is part of a larger process that will succeed.
Encouragement not to grow weary in doing good because in due season we will reap if we don't give up, ideal for work still underway.
